Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, A.K. GANGULY
A B Penal Code, 1860 - ss.302 1208 and 201 - Death allegedly caused due to poisonous injections administered C into body of deceased by accused-appellants - Prosecution case resting on circumstantial evidence - Trial court convicted the appellants - High Court upheld conviction - Justification of a case rests squarely on circumstantial evidence, inference of guilt can be o justified only when all incriminating facts and circumstances are incompatible with innocence of the accused or guilt of any other person - Circumstances from which inference as to guilt of accused is drawn have to be
